1. Simulate data for SVM with linear kernel

(top)

##----------
## Simulate Data
set.seed(1)
size=200
x <- matrix(rnorm(size*2), ncol=2)
y <- c(rep(-1,100) , rep(1,100) )
x[y==1,] <-  x[y==1,] + 1
sim.data=data.frame(x=x, y=as.factor(y))
plot(x, col=ifelse(y>0, "red", "blue"))

test = sample(1:200, 100)
sim.data.01 <- sim.data[test,]     # Training data set
sim.data.TS <- sim.data[-test,]    # Testing data set

# Visualize Training and Test Set
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
plot(sim.data.01[,1:2], col=ifelse(as.numeric(sim.data.01[,3])==1, "red", "blue"), main="Training Set")
plot(sim.data.TS[,1:2], col=ifelse(as.numeric(sim.data.01[,3])==1, "red", "blue"), main="Test Set")

##----------
## a. Analyze Training Set with SVM (cost is 10)
library (e1071)         # install.packages("e1071")
svmfit=svm(y~., data=sim.data.01, kernel="linear",  cost=10, scale =FALSE )

plot(svmfit, sim.data.01)  # gives SVM classification plot

svmfit$index    # gives ix of support vectors
##  [1]  1  5  8 12 25 26 27 28 30 31 40 44 45 49 50 59 62 63 70 71 79 80 81 84 89
## [26] 91 93 94 95 96 98  3  4  7 11 15 22 32 34 35 37 38 46 47 48 51 52 55 58 60
## [51] 67 68 75 76 82 83 86 87 88 90 99
summary(svmfit)
## 
## Call:
## svm(formula = y ~ ., data = sim.data.01, kernel = "linear", cost = 10, 
##     scale = FALSE)
## 
## 
## Parameters:
##    SVM-Type:  C-classification 
##  SVM-Kernel:  linear 
##        cost:  10 
## 
## Number of Support Vectors:  61
## 
##  ( 31 30 )
## 
## 
## Number of Classes:  2 
## 
## Levels: 
##  -1 1
##----------
## b. Analyze Training Set with SVM (cost is 0.1)
library (e1071)         # install.packages("e1071")
svmfit =svm(y~., data=sim.data.01, kernel="linear", cost=0.1, scale =FALSE )

plot(svmfit, sim.data.01)

svmfit$index    # support vectors are different now
##  [1]   1   5   8  12  14  25  26  27  28  29  30  31  33  40  44  45  49  50  59
## [20]  62  63  70  71  72  74  79  80  81  84  89  91  93  94  95  96  98   3   4
## [39]   7  10  11  15  16  22  32  34  35  37  38  41  42  46  47  48  51  52  55
## [58]  58  60  67  68  75  76  82  83  86  87  88  90  99 100
##----------
## c. Pick best Cost with 5-fold CV
library (e1071)         # install.packages("e1071")
set.seed(1)
tune.out = tune(svm, y~., data=sim.data.01, kernel ="linear",
                ranges=list(cost=c(0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 5, 10, 100)),
                tunecontrol = tune.control(cross = 5))
summary(tune.out)
## 
## Parameter tuning of 'svm':
## 
## - sampling method: 5-fold cross validation 
## 
## - best parameters:
##  cost
##   0.1
## 
## - best performance: 0.24 
## 
## - Detailed performance results:
##    cost error dispersion
## 1 1e-03  0.50  0.1695582
## 2 1e-02  0.34  0.1193734
## 3 1e-01  0.24  0.1294218
## 4 1e+00  0.24  0.1341641
## 5 5e+00  0.24  0.1341641
## 6 1e+01  0.25  0.1541104
## 7 1e+02  0.26  0.1474788
## Extract the model with best cost
bestmod <- tune.out$best.model
summary(bestmod)
## 
## Call:
## best.tune(METHOD = svm, train.x = y ~ ., data = sim.data.01, ranges = list(cost = c(0.001, 
##     0.01, 0.1, 1, 5, 10, 100)), tunecontrol = tune.control(cross = 5), 
##     kernel = "linear")
## 
## 
## Parameters:
##    SVM-Type:  C-classification 
##  SVM-Kernel:  linear 
##        cost:  0.1 
## 
## Number of Support Vectors:  71
## 
##  ( 36 35 )
## 
## 
## Number of Classes:  2 
## 
## Levels: 
##  -1 1
plot(bestmod, sim.data.01)

##----------
## Best Model
svmfit = svm(y~., data=sim.data.01, kernel="linear", cost=100)
plot(svmfit, sim.data.01)   # Training Fit

plot(svmfit, sim.data.TS)   # Test Fit

Y.pred=predict(bestmod, sim.data.TS[,1:2])   # predict using bestmod
table(predict=Y.pred , truth=sim.data.TS$y )
##        truth
## predict -1  1
##      -1 40 11
##      1  10 39


2. Simulate data for SVM with radial kernel

(top)

##----------
## Simulate Data
set.seed (1)
x = matrix(rnorm (200*2) , ncol=2)
x[1:100 ,]  = x[1:100 ,] + 2
x[101:150 ,]= x[101:150 ,] - 2
y = c(rep (1 ,150) ,rep (2 ,50))-1
sim.data2 = data.frame(x=x, y=as.factor(y))

plot(x, col=ifelse(y>0, "red", "blue"))

set.seed (1)
test = sample(1:200, 100)
sim.data2.01 <- sim.data2[test,]     # Training data set
sim.data2.TS <- sim.data2[-test,]    # Testing data set

# Visualize Training and Test Set
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
plot(sim.data2.01[,1:2], col=ifelse(as.numeric(sim.data2.01[,3])==1, "red", "blue"), main="Training Set")
plot(sim.data2.TS[,1:2], col=ifelse(as.numeric(sim.data2.01[,3])==1, "red", "blue"), main="Test Set")

##----------
## a. Analyze Training Set with SVM (gamma=1, cost=1)
svmfit = svm(y~., data=sim.data2.01, kernel="radial", gamma=1, cost=1)
plot(svmfit , sim.data2.01)

summary(svmfit)
## 
## Call:
## svm(formula = y ~ ., data = sim.data2.01, kernel = "radial", gamma = 1, 
##     cost = 1)
## 
## 
## Parameters:
##    SVM-Type:  C-classification 
##  SVM-Kernel:  radial 
##        cost:  1 
## 
## Number of Support Vectors:  41
## 
##  ( 22 19 )
## 
## 
## Number of Classes:  2 
## 
## Levels: 
##  0 1
##----------
## b. Analyze Training Set with SVM (gamma=1, cost=100000)
svmfit = svm(y~., data=sim.data2.01, kernel="radial", gamma=1, cost=10000)
plot(svmfit, sim.data2.01)

##----------
## c. Pick best Cost and Gamma with 10-fold CV
tune.out = tune(svm, y~., data=sim.data2.01, kernel ="radial",
                ranges = list(cost=c(0.1 ,1 ,10 ,100 ,1000),
                              gamma=c(0.5,1,2,3,4)),
                tunecontrol = tune.control(cross = 5))
summary(tune.out)
## 
## Parameter tuning of 'svm':
## 
## - sampling method: 5-fold cross validation 
## 
## - best parameters:
##  cost gamma
##     1   0.5
## 
## - best performance: 0.1 
## 
## - Detailed performance results:
##     cost gamma error dispersion
## 1  1e-01   0.5  0.29 0.06519202
## 2  1e+00   0.5  0.10 0.07071068
## 3  1e+01   0.5  0.12 0.10954451
## 4  1e+02   0.5  0.16 0.11937336
## 5  1e+03   0.5  0.19 0.10839742
## 6  1e-01   1.0  0.30 0.09354143
## 7  1e+00   1.0  0.11 0.08944272
## 8  1e+01   1.0  0.14 0.12942179
## 9  1e+02   1.0  0.18 0.11510864
## 10 1e+03   1.0  0.19 0.08215838
## 11 1e-01   2.0  0.31 0.08215838
## 12 1e+00   2.0  0.12 0.10954451
## 13 1e+01   2.0  0.17 0.10954451
## 14 1e+02   2.0  0.20 0.09354143
## 15 1e+03   2.0  0.22 0.09082951
## 16 1e-01   3.0  0.29 0.06519202
## 17 1e+00   3.0  0.13 0.13038405
## 18 1e+01   3.0  0.17 0.10954451
## 19 1e+02   3.0  0.22 0.12041595
## 20 1e+03   3.0  0.23 0.11510864
## 21 1e-01   4.0  0.29 0.06519202
## 22 1e+00   4.0  0.14 0.11937336
## 23 1e+01   4.0  0.19 0.12449900
## 24 1e+02   4.0  0.24 0.10246951
## 25 1e+03   4.0  0.25 0.11726039
tune.out$best.model
## 
## Call:
## best.tune(METHOD = svm, train.x = y ~ ., data = sim.data2.01, ranges = list(cost = c(0.1, 
##     1, 10, 100, 1000), gamma = c(0.5, 1, 2, 3, 4)), tunecontrol = tune.control(cross = 5), 
##     kernel = "radial")
## 
## 
## Parameters:
##    SVM-Type:  C-classification 
##  SVM-Kernel:  radial 
##        cost:  1 
## 
## Number of Support Vectors:  41
tune.out$best.model$gamma
## [1] 0.5
## Calculate Test CM from the best model
table(true=sim.data2.TS[, "y"],
      pred=predict(tune.out$best.model, sim.data2.TS[, 1:2]))
##     pred
## true  0  1
##    0 72  7
##    1  1 20
##----------
## Best Model
svmfit = svm(y~., data=sim.data2.01, kernel="radial", gamma=1, cost=100)
plot(svmfit, sim.data2.01)   # Training Fit

plot(svmfit, sim.data2.TS)   # Test Fit

##-------------------------------------------------
## 1. Simulate data for SVM with linear kernel


##----------
## Simulate Data
set.seed(1)
size=200
x <- matrix(rnorm(size*2), ncol=2)
y <- c(rep(-1,100) , rep(1,100) )
x[y==1,] <-  x[y==1,] + 1
sim.data=data.frame(x=x, y=as.factor(y))
plot(x, col=ifelse(y>0, "red", "blue"))


test = sample(1:200, 100)
sim.data.01 <- sim.data[test,]     # Training data set
sim.data.TS <- sim.data[-test,]    # Testing data set

# Visualize Training and Test Set
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
plot(sim.data.01[,1:2], col=ifelse(as.numeric(sim.data.01[,3])==1, "red", "blue"), main="Training Set")
plot(sim.data.TS[,1:2], col=ifelse(as.numeric(sim.data.01[,3])==1, "red", "blue"), main="Test Set")




##----------
## a. Analyze Training Set with SVM (cost is 10)
library (e1071)         # install.packages("e1071")
svmfit=svm(y~., data=sim.data.01, kernel="linear",  cost=10, scale =FALSE )

plot(svmfit, sim.data.01)  # gives SVM classification plot

svmfit$index    # gives ix of support vectors

summary(svmfit)


##----------
## b. Analyze Training Set with SVM (cost is 0.1)
library (e1071)         # install.packages("e1071")
svmfit =svm(y~., data=sim.data.01, kernel="linear", cost=0.1, scale =FALSE )

plot(svmfit, sim.data.01)

svmfit$index    # support vectors are different now


##----------
## c. Pick best Cost with 5-fold CV
library (e1071)         # install.packages("e1071")
set.seed(1)
tune.out = tune(svm, y~., data=sim.data.01, kernel ="linear",
                ranges=list(cost=c(0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 5, 10, 100)),
                tunecontrol = tune.control(cross = 5))
summary(tune.out)


## Extract the model with best cost
bestmod <- tune.out$best.model
summary(bestmod)

plot(bestmod, sim.data.01)



##----------
## d. Apply Best model to Test Set
Y.pred=predict(bestmod, sim.data.TS[,1:2])   # predict using bestmod
table(predict=Y.pred , truth=sim.data.TS$y )

## 2. Simulate data for SVM with radial kernel


##----------
## Simulate Data
set.seed (1)
x = matrix(rnorm (200*2) , ncol=2)
x[1:100 ,]  = x[1:100 ,] + 2
x[101:150 ,]= x[101:150 ,] - 2
y = c(rep (1 ,150) ,rep (2 ,50))-1
sim.data2 = data.frame(x=x, y=as.factor(y))

plot(x, col=ifelse(y>0, "red", "blue"))

set.seed (1)
test = sample(1:200, 100)
sim.data2.01 <- sim.data2[test,]     # Training data set
sim.data2.TS <- sim.data2[-test,]    # Testing data set

# Visualize Training and Test Set
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
plot(sim.data2.01[,1:2], col=ifelse(as.numeric(sim.data2.01[,3])==1, "red", "blue"), main="Training Set")
plot(sim.data2.TS[,1:2], col=ifelse(as.numeric(sim.data2.01[,3])==1, "red", "blue"), main="Test Set")


##----------
## a. Analyze Training Set with SVM (gamma=1, cost=1)
svmfit = svm(y~., data=sim.data2.01, kernel="radial", gamma=1, cost=1)
plot(svmfit , sim.data2.01)

summary(svmfit)

##----------
## b. Analyze Training Set with SVM (gamma=1, cost=100000)
svmfit = svm(y~., data=sim.data2.01, kernel="radial", gamma=1, cost=10000)
plot(svmfit, sim.data2.01)


##----------
## c. Pick best Cost and Gamma with 10-fold CV
tune.out = tune(svm, y~., data=sim.data2.01, kernel ="radial",
                ranges = list(cost=c(0.1 ,1 ,10 ,100 ,1000),
                              gamma=c(0.5,1,2,3,4)),
                tunecontrol = tune.control(cross = 5))
summary(tune.out)

tune.out$best.model
tune.out$best.model$gamma

## Calculate Test CM from the best model
table(true=sim.data2.TS[, "y"],
      pred=predict(tune.out$best.model, sim.data2.TS[, 1:2]))

##----------
## Best Model
svmfit = svm(y~., data=sim.data2.01, kernel="radial", gamma=1, cost=100)
plot(svmfit, sim.data2.01)   # Training Fit
plot(svmfit, sim.data2.TS)   # Test Fit
